name: BloodBound
source:
You’re caught between two rival vampire clans – one bathed in light, the other thriving in shadow. You must choose who to trust, who to love, and whose hunger to feed.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你被夹在两个敌对的吸血鬼部落之间——一个沐浴在光明中，另一个在阴影中蓬勃发展。你必须选择信任谁、爱谁以及满足谁的饥饿。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
